descriptionFull: The yellow-rumped warbler ( Setophaga coronata ) is a North American bird species combining four closely related forms: the eastern myrtle warbler (ssp coronata ); its western counterpart, Audubon's warbler (ssp group auduboni ); the northwest Mexican black-fronted warbler (ssp nigrifrons ); and the Guatemalan Goldman's warbler (ssp goldmani ).
